items.text: Kirk Cousins remains the Raiders' starter; Fernando Mendoza will not play this week.

Las Vegas (Wednesday): EDGE Patrick Johnson (stinger) did not practice; TE Brock Bowers (calf), LB Quay Walker (chest), OT DJ Glaze (ankle) and DT Foley Fatukasi (shoulder) were limited. WR Jack Bech (IR) is more likely for Week 9.

New York (Wednesday): EDGE David Bailey (groin), EDGE Joseph Ossai (ankle), OL Max Mitchell (concussion) and DT T'Vondre Sweat (knee, expected to miss a while) did not practice; RB Breece Hall (quad), RB Braelon Allen (ankle) and OL Dylan Parham (knee) were limited. Watch Friday's report for the pass rushers.
